gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.760985 36.173714)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.760985 36.173714)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.960317 35.59114)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-106.960317 35.59114)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Tusculum University Historical District, Greeneville, TN'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Ojito Wilderness Study Area, San Luis, NM'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH tusculum_point AS (

ojito_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-106.960317, 35.59114), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
tusculum_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(t.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us, tusculum_point t
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(t.geom::geometry, 4326))
),
ojito_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, ST_Transform(o.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us, ojito_point o
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(o.geom::geometry, 4326))
)
SELECT 
  'Tusculum University Historical District, Greeneville, TN' AS name,
  t.elevation
FROM tusculum_elevation t
WHERE t.elevation > (SELECT elevation FROM ojito_elevation)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Ojito Wilderness Study Area, San Luis, NM' AS name,
  o.elevation
FROM ojito_elevation o
WHERE o.elevation > (SELECT elevation FROM tusculum_elevation)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Tusculum University Historical District, Greeneville, TN' AS name,
  t.elevation
FROM tusculum_elevation t
WHERE (SELECT elevation FROM ojito_elevation) IS NULL OR t.elevation IS NULL;
